The Reach

Where the Seeds Have Landed

true proportions — October 31, 2026

The map so far — every country, drawn to scale

Not a scoreboard — a planting record. Each bar is sized by the chapters actually read.

The longer windows gather day by day — each morning’s count of chapters read by country, added up since October 18, 2026. The heartbeat counts a country only when a reader’s visit carries one, so a window names the countries it could see; the totals line below counts every chapter.

Lit today: United States

  • Word of God Risen, chapters read by country, today (October 31, 2026): United States — 18 chapters read, 100 percent
  • Body Heartbeat totals since October 15, 2026: 472 chapters read, 296 chapters heard, 166 listened through, 7 books finished. Listened through counts a chapter once the listener has heard at least 80 percent of it played. 163 chapters were marked 'I listened' by their own listeners — the reader's word, counted separately from the measured listened through.

Counted by the app’s own Body Heartbeat, totals only — no reader is ever tracked.

The bars name the countries a visit carried; chapters counted without a country still count in the totals.

Lit today: Florida, Iowa

  • Word of God Risen, chapters read by state in the United States, today (October 31, 2026): Florida — 17 chapters read, 94 percent; Iowa — 1 chapter read, 6 percent

Counted by the same Body Heartbeat, one step closer to home — a state is counted only when a reader’s visit carries one, so the bars name the states it could see; the true count for every state is at least what’s shown. State counting began October 19, 2026, and gathers morning by morning from that day.

Milestones

The story so far

newest first
  • Oct 20, 2026 Oregon joins the map — a reader in a new state is counted the same day the counter is healed and proves itself.
  • Oct 19, 2026 The front doors open — Start Here and the Key Ring go live; everything now has a door a friend can be handed.
  • Oct 18, 2026 “Come and Hear” is released — Jason’s testimony film goes public, and the Open Door Short with it.
  • Oct 17, 2026 The first chapter film — the Gospel of Mark, chapter 1, released whole: Teddy reads it, and the film carries it.
  • Oct 15, 2026 The counting begins — the Body Heartbeat starts counting chapters read and heard — totals only, no names, ever.
  • Oct 14, 2026 First traffic read: the Word reached Kenya — the site counters open for the first time: 66 visitors and 1,157 page views at Word of God Risen in a single week, readers arriving by way of YouTube — and Kenya planted among the countries reached.
  • Oct 14, 2026 The Field Report is born — the numbers get a home of their own, and a daily heartbeat keeps it honest.
  • Oct 11, 2026 Daily Encouragement Ep 1, “One Seed a Day,” published — a new series takes root.
  • Oct 8, 2026 The whole Bible, read aloud — Teddy finishes all 1,503 chapters; every chapter of the Bible now has a voice, free to anyone who taps Listen.
We plant. We water. God gives the increase.
That’s the whole strategy — and it’s working.
TruVINE
Faithfulness over numbers — if one seed is planted a day, that’s good enough.
